question: Up to which financial year has the ‘New India Literacy Programme’ been launched to impart foundational literacy and numeracy, critical life skills, vocational skills, basic and continuing education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**FY 2027**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'New India Literacy Programme' is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at addressing the literacy gap in the country.
 
• The programme focuses on imparting foundational literacy and numeracy to non-literates in the age group of 15 years and above.
 
• It also aims to provide critical life skills, vocational skills, and basic as well as continuing education to enhance the employability of the beneficiaries.
 
• The programme has been launched to be implemented up to the financial year 2027, ensuring a long-term commitment to improving literacy rates across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Foundational Literacy and Numeracy:**

 
 
• Refers to the basic ability to read and write, as well as perform basic arithmetic operations.
 
• This is essential for individuals to function effectively in society and access further educational opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Critical Life Skills:**
 
 
• These include skills such as financial literacy, digital literacy, health and hygiene awareness, and other essential life competencies.
 
• They are aimed at empowering individuals to make informed decisions and improve their quality of life.
 
 
 
• **Vocational Skills:**
 
 
• These are job-specific skills that enable individuals to obtain and retain employment in various industries.
 
• Vocational training is a key component in enhancing the employability and economic independence of individuals.
 
 
 
• **Basic and Continuing Education:**
 
 
• This refers to the ongoing educational opportunities provided to individuals to ensure they can continue to learn and develop throughout their lives.
 
• It includes adult education programs, skill development courses, and other educational initiatives aimed at lifelong learning.
